topic: Temperature and its effect on the state of matter
key_concepts: Heating a solid candle wax can melt it into liquid
Cooling melted candle wax can harden it back into solid
Temperature is measured with a thermometer in degrees Celsius
Heat causes molecules to change their arrangement
Solids and liquids have different molecular arrangements
Ice melts when its temperature increases
Continued heating changes liquid water to water vapor or steam
Boiling or evaporation reduces the volume of liquid water
Matter can change between solid, liquid, and gas states
Removing heat can change a liquid to a solid
